_why: Headline quotes that tools/check_evidence.py cannot find in their own paper. The list is EMPTY: every source_quote in estimates.csv is now a sentence its own paper prints. It was not always so -- ten entries sat here quoting this site's catalogue abstract instead of the article, which is the substitution the gate exists to catch, and three of those rationales quietly went false the moment a catalogue abstract was corrected. A quote taken from the catalogue matches the page's own summary while being absent from the paper, so it proves nothing. Keep this file empty: if a quote cannot be found in the paper, the repair is to quote the paper, not to record why the gate may be ignored.
